Job Description

Global Risk Analytics (GRA) is a sub-line of business within Global Risk Management (GRM). The GRA team provides quantitative capabilities supporting global risk management and capital management and develops a consistent set of risk and capital models and analytical tools that support decision making across the bank.

This role is responsible for analyzing data flows, business processes, and operational controls supporting critical enterprise activities. The position applies analytical thinking, process management, risk assessment, and technology capabilities to identify data quality concerns, process inefficiencies, control gaps, and operational risks while supporting efforts to improve data integrity, operational effectiveness, and business outcomes. The role partners with stakeholders across business, risk, finance, operations, technology, audit, and other functions to support issue resolution, process improvement, and informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate business processes, data flows, and operational data to identify data integrity and quality concerns, trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities to improve the accuracy, completeness, and effectiveness of critical business processes and outcomes.
• Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, finance, operations, technology, and audit functions to support process evaluations, issue resolution, and improvement initiatives.
• Leverage data analytics, reporting, automation, AI-enabled tools, and quantitative techniques to identify trends, communicate insights, and improve business outcomes.
• Develop reporting, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate performance metrics, risks, trends, and opportunities to stakeholders.
• Support governance, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen controls, enhance process resiliency, and increase operational effectiveness.

Required Skills

• Learning Agility: Quickly assimilates new concepts, technologies, business processes, and organizational priorities while adapting effectively to changing business needs.
• Process Excellence: Applies a process-centric mindset to understand end-to-end workflows, identify inefficiencies, evaluate controls, and support operational improvements.
• Data & Analytical Thinking: Leverages analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving techniques to evaluate complex data flows, identify risks, uncover insights, and support data-driven decision-making.
• Risk & Controls Mindset: Applies risk management principles and sound judgment to identify, assess, and mitigate operational, process, compliance, and data-related risks.
• Technology & Innovation: Utilizes data analytics, SQL, automation, AI, GenAI, process analysis, or related technologies to identify issues, improve decision-making, strengthen controls, and increase operational efficiency.
• Stakeholder Management & Communication: Strong communication, and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively across functions, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results.
• Business & Financial Acumen: Demonstrates understanding of financial services, banking, risk management, operations and governance.
• Regulated Environment Experience: Experience operating in environments where data quality, risk management, controls, compliance, and operational resiliency are critical to business performance.

Minimum Education Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Information Management, Data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, or related field

The Business Resilience Manager will lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Solventum’s enterprise Business Resilience program. The role will establish the governance, methodologies, standards, tools, and assurance activities necessary to strengthen organizational preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience across Solventum’s global operations.

Working within Global Security and in close partnership with business units and functions, the Manager will coordinate Business Resilience with Crisis Management, Technology Resilience, Cybersecurity Incident Response, Manufacturing and Operational Technology resilience, Supply Chain, Enterprise Risk Management, and other related disciplines. The role will help ensure that business-defined recovery requirements, technology recovery capabilities, operational dependencies, and crisis decision-making processes are aligned.

The Manager will lead enterprise Business Impact Analysis and continuity-planning cycles, establish minimum program and plan requirements, maintain an integrated view of critical business services and dependencies, oversee exercising and corrective-action management. The role will also support the delivery of Internal Audit and management remediation commitments related to business resilience.

This is a hands-on program management role requiring the ability to translate strategy and audit requirements into practical methodologies, accountable workstreams, measurable outcomes, and sustainable business practices.

Program Governance

Lead the operationalization of Solventum’s Business Resilience governance framework.

Develop and maintain the BCM operating model, program charter, policies, procedures, methodologies, standards, and annual program plan.

Identify and implement opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence and automation to strengthen business resilience capabilities, including risk identification, scenario analysis, business impact analysis, crisis preparedness and response.

Serve as principal program lead for the BCM system and associated program data.

Coordinate alignment across Business Continuity, Crisis Management, Technology Resilience, Cybersecurity Incident Response, Manufacturing and Operational Technology resilience, Supply Chain resilience, Enterprise Risk Management, and other related programs.

Translate Internal Audit, regulatory, and management findings into structured remediation plans with defined owners, milestones, dependencies, evidence requirements, and target outcomes.

Monitor remediation progress, challenge delays or gaps, escalate material risks, and prepare regular status updates for program and executive governance bodies.

Design and facilitate discussion-based and operational exercises that test governance, plans, recovery strategies, communication methods, dependencies, and decision-making.

Establish an exception-management process for business areas unable to meet BCM standards or documented recovery requirements.

Maintain defensible evidence supporting program implementation, control operation, management oversight, and remediation closure.

Establish a consistent after-action process, including observations, root causes, accountable corrective actions, target dates, validation evidence, and closure approval.

Analyze exercise and incident results to identify recurring or enterprise-wide weaknesses.

Develop executive dashboards covering BIA coverage, plan quality, exercising, recovery capability gaps, overdue actions, exceptions, and remediation performance.

Prepare regular program reports that identify trends, systemic risks, decisions required, and areas requiring leadership intervention.

Create guidance, templates, toolkits, and communications that help business teams meet BCM requirements consistently.

Champion responsible adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to improve resilience insights, accelerate decision-making, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the business resilience program.

Represent the BCM program in governance forums, audits, assessments, major projects, and relevant risk discussions.

Business Impact Analysis and Continuity Risk

Own and continuously improve the enterprise BIA and continuity-risk assessment methodology.

Lead the enterprise BIA cycle and ensure appropriate coverage of critical business services, processes, products, locations, and supporting operations.

Establish consistent criteria for assessing operational, customer, patient, financial, regulatory, legal, reputational, and strategic impacts.

Guide business leaders and process owners in establishing recovery time objectives, recovery point objectives, impact tolerances, minimum resource requirements, and recovery priorities.

Maintain an enterprise inventory of dependencies, including people, technology, data, facilities, suppliers, operational technology, equipment, utilities, logistics, and interdependent processes.

Analyze BIA results to identify concentrations of risk, single points of failure, conflicting recovery requirements, and systemic dependencies.

Facilitate alignment between business-defined recovery requirements and Technology Resilience application tiering, IT contingency planning, recovery strategies, and testing priorities.

Escalate material gaps between required recovery outcomes and demonstrated recovery capabilities.

Crisis Management and Incident Support

Support with maintaining & improving Solventum’s Crisis Management Framework, including escalation criteria, team structures, roles, decision rights, communication protocols, activation procedures, and supporting playbooks.

Ensure the Crisis Management Framework remains integrated with the wider Business Resilience program and aligned with business continuity and technology recovery arrangements.

Provide specialist advice during crisis activations and significant disruptions.

Support or coordinate situation reporting, action tracking, decision logging, stakeholder briefings, response documentation, and transition-to-recovery activities.

Support with post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are translated into sustainable corrective actions.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND 10 years of experience in business resilience, disaster recovery, crisis management, risk management, or a related field in a private, public, government or military environment
OR

• High school diploma/GED and 14 years of experience in business resilience, disaster recovery, crisis management, risk management, or a related field in a private, public, government or military environment

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

• Professional certification in business continuity and/or emergency management, such as CBCI, CBCP, MBCI (previous or current)
• Experience with ISO 22301

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

• Proficiency with business continuity software platforms (ServiceNow BCM) and emergency notification systems (e.g., Horizon, Everbridge)
• Knowledge of IT infrastructure, application recovery, and data protection principles sufficient to partner effectively with IT disaster recovery teams.
• Familiarity with relevant standards, regulations, and frameworks, including:

Our ideal candidate is a passionate technology leader with an action-oriented, collaborative mindset, who operates with a vision for the future , while deliver ing benefits t hat exceed industry expectations .

As a member of Avionics product lines leadership and key partner to our Advanced CNS Sandbox , the successful candidate will be a core contribut or to strategic planning, business development, and engagement with our internal and external stakeholders. As a technology leader the candidate is expected to contribute to technical staff development , evaluate and take action on the performance of self and others, and proactively plan for team and customer needs, while operating with full integrity.

This is an onsite position in Melbourne, Florida.
